source: Utah Avalanche Center, Avalanche Route Ratings for Selected Touring Routes in the Central Wasatch
notes: Ratings rate interaction with avalanche terrain on the specific out-and-back route only, not adjacent terrain, and not difficulty or fitness.

Ratings use 10 weighted parameters: slope steepness, slope shape, forest density, terrain traps, avalanche frequency, start zone density, runout zone, interaction with avalanche paths, route options, exposure time.
Values below are exactly as stated on each UAC route page. null = not stated on the page.
Road miles: LCC routes measured from the electronic sign at the canyon mouth; Millcreek routes from the entrance booth; BCC routes are 'miles up the canyon'.
No route page publishes coordinates, GPX, or KML. Line geometry is not yet captured.
